description:
A powerful ultra-lightweight floating browser.

One of the core functions of Floweb is to convert any web page into a WebApp, allowing you to start and run web pages just like using local applications. Now you can quickly add the most commonly used websites or services, such as email, social media, online documents, etc., to your desktop for one-click access.
🚀 A new workspace: group dock and tab bar on the left, sites stay in groups without scattering windows; the home icon library opens a separate window by default, or you can keep it inside the workspace. Sign in to official Cloud to sync your setup—site sign-ins are never uploaded. Install, enable, and share page scripts from the script library; the keychain saves accounts and fills them when you open a site. Workbench lock protects your desk; memory use and hibernation keep the background light; ad blocking and unread badges work out of the box. Each account can use its own proxy; AI access lets an assistant operate your sites on this computer. Theme packs, custom colors, and an online wallpaper gallery; Settings regrouped into Preferences, Sync, License, and About; open local pages, search titles more easily, follow the shortcut guide, and switch windows quickly.
